verdict.rationale: Gitea provides building blocks for governance—Actions-based CI/CD (gitea-docs-2), permission management and ACLs (gitea-docs-7), and PR-based code review workflows (gitea-docs-3)—plus API/webhooks for custom policy automation (gitea-docs-4). However, there's no direct evidence of org-wide branch protection templates, mandatory status-check enforcement across all repos, or centralized policy dashboards that a devops-lead would use to enforce standards uniformly; community feedback also notes scaling pain points once organizations grow (gitea-comm-13, gitea-comm-15). Missing for 10: explicit branch-protection/required-checks documentation, organization-wide policy templates, and independent evidence of successful multi-team governance enforcement.
